liamwynne.erd-studio/heartbeat.comment: One anonymous usage summary per UTC day, sent the day after ERD Studio was used. No names, paths, file contents or error text. Raw rows are deleted after 90 days.

installId.comment: Random UUID v4 minted by the extension and replaced every 30 days. Not vscode.env.machineId.

day.comment: The UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) the counts describe.

activation.comment: project_found or no_project, for the most recent activation that day.

hasSemanticDir.comment: Whether the dbt project has an .erd-studio folder.

canvasOpens.comment: Diagrams opened that day, capped at 200.

stages.comment: Stages viewed, a subset of [logical, physical].

schemaFormats.comment: Domain file formats opened, a subset of [v5, v4].

manifest.comment: State of dbt's manifest.json when a diagram was opened: ok, missing, stale or unknown.

catalog.comment: Whether a dbt catalog.json was present.

features.comment: Use counts (0-100 each, zero keys omitted) keyed only by: physicalStage, compare, syncPlan, launchClaude, dbtCompile, annotation, autoLayout, addModel, addRelationship, harnessInstallClaude, harnessInstallCopilot, harnessInstallGemini, harnessInstallCodex, migrateV5, feedbackOpened.

errors.comment: Failure counts (0-100 each, zero keys omitted) keyed only by: manifestMissing, manifestMalformed, manifestTimeout, catalogUnreadable, domainLoad, modelFileParse, layersInvalid, editRejected, migrationFailed, other. Never messages or stack traces.
